page.notes: The left-edge strip belongs to the neighbouring page and was omitted. Italic/roman distinction within the running text is approximate; the marginal numbers "III." and "IV." are placed at the lines where they stand. Some italic word boundaries and the abbreviation "esl" (est) in "definitum esl" may be misprints for "est" and are copied as seen. The word "ædificator" is copied as printed; the diphthong is uncertain. No catchword is visible.
